outcome: Psychological development of children at age 10 years
Scores on externalising and internalising subscales of the South African Child Assessment Schedule (SACAS)
cohort: 1866 mother-child pairs from the socioeconomically disadvantaged Soweto area of Johannesburg, South Africa, participating in the Birth to Twenty cohort study
finding: Children whose mothers had postnatal depression at 6 months were more than twice as likely to have significant psychological difficulties at age 10 years, even after adjusting for socioeconomic status and maternal depression at 10 years.
